Hi Mina / Marissa,

Following up on the unusual spikes we saw yesterday on our integration (logs attached). Our security team has asked that we receive the most recent penetration test report (or a redacted executive summary) and a concise remediation status for any findings classified as High/Critical. We flagged this to our security leadership and they are pausing the next rollout until they can validate the controls.

Specifically we need:
- The most recent pen test executive summary (redacted for customer data and internal IP).
- A short remediation table: finding id, severity, status (open/in progress/closed), and ETA for open items.
- Confirmation of whether the anomalous behaviour could be related to the finding labeled AUTH-003 from the 2026-01 assessment.

I appreciate a quick turnaround — our CISO wants these by EOD Friday. If needed we can do a 30-min call to walk through.

Thanks,
Eileen Park
Director, InfoSec — MediaLogic
[eileen.park@medialogic.com]

Hi Eileen / Benjamin,

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. I understand the urgency — sorry to hear you had to pause rollout.

What we can provide immediately:
- A redacted executive summary of our last internal + third-party penetration test (attached). This omits customer-identifying data and internal IPs.
- A remediation status snapshot for High/Critical items (see table in the PDF).
- Preliminary note: AUTH-003 (authentication token rotation policy) was included in the January assessment; our remediation for it was completed and verified in March 2026. I will attach the short verification note.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please review the attached redacted summary. If you need the full report under an NDA/PA, we can arrange a mutual NDA + in-person redaction review.
2) We can schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow morning to walk through the high items and correlate the logs you shared to our telemetry.
3) I will loop Legal (David) to confirm redaction scope and to produce the remediation table in CSV if you prefer that format.
